free_tier_limits.correction: Not applicable: Personio has no ongoing free tier, and custom API access is listed under the paid Core Pro plan.

rate_limits.correction: Published limits exist; GET /v1/company/employees is limited to 300 requests per minute with a 15-requests-per-second burst limit.

cors.correction: no; Personio uses CORS to prevent browsers from retrieving data directly from its APIs.

notes: Operational as checked on 2026-08-11. Personio now also exposes substantial v2 APIs using OAuth 2.0 client credentials. The cited v1 employee endpoint remains current, but v1 attendance and projects are scheduled for deprecation on 2027-01-31, so presenting /v1 as the only API generation is incomplete.
